newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ WHOLESALE ELECTRICITY PRICES MIXED IN JULY-EMCO.
newsitem.headline: NZ WHOLESALE ELECTRICITY PRICES MIXED IN JULY-EMCO.

text.p: Average wholesale New Zealand electricity prices fell slightly in the North Island in July but rose in the South Island, electricity market operator EMCO said on Monday.
The average wholesale electricity price in the North Island (at the Haywards reference point) in July was 5.79 NZ cents per kilowatt hour compared with 5.82 cents in June and 4.92 cents in May.
In the South Island, at the Benmore reference point, the average wholesale electricity price was 5.82 cents per kilowatt hour compared with 5.74 cents in June and 4.655 cents in May.

"However, during the month of July the trend for both islands was downward, with a high of around 7.5 cents at the start of the month for both islands, to a low of approximately 4.5 cents at the end of the month for the North Island and slightly lower for the South Island," EMCO said.
